title: Does steering a model toward 'corrigibility' survive when the model is given a conflicting goal?

original_idea.body: Construct prompts giving a task goal plus a conflicting correction/shutdown instruction, extract a corrigibility vector, and measure whether steering raises compliance under increasing goal-conflict pressure.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: corrigibility steering under goal conflict targets a core long-horizon alignment property.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Corrigibility scenario set + steering under pressure; scenario design adds difficulty.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable though scenario construction is nontrivial.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Corrigibility/model-organism work labs underweight, open models, foundational long-horizon.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: A fresh angle on corrigibility under pressure.
